stories.title: Flagg's prized 1-of-1 card found in Rhode Island
stories.summary: Cooper Flagg's coveted one-of-one numbered rookie debut patch autograph card was found in Rhode Island on Monday night.

stories.title: 16-minute delay in Sox-Jays leads to belated run
stories.summary: A chaotic, inning-ending double play resulted in a 16-minute delay and a belated Red Sox run during Boston's 2-1 loss to the Blue Jays in Toronto on Monday night.

stories.title: Trump warns against replacing FIFA chief Infantino
stories.summary: President Donald Trump said in a social media post Monday that ousting FIFA president Gianni Infantino would be a "terrible mistake."

stories.title: Carrington: Did not link ejection to white privilege
stories.summary: DiJonai Carrington says she never claimed that the assessment of a flagrant foul 2 on her in a game vs. the Fever was the result of white privilege.

stories.title: Sources: Cowboys, Williams reach $105.9M deal
stories.summary: The Cowboys and star defensive tackle Quinnen Williams have agreed to terms on a three-year, $105.9 million extension to make him one of the highest-paid defensive linemen in the NFL, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
